services.title: Calibrated workcell digital model
services.summary: Replace nominal geometry with installation-specific robot, tooling, fixtures and coordinate frames.
services.requirements: Cell CAD, robot factory calibration, measured base / TCP frames, payload and acceptance tolerances.
services.deliverable: A versioned model and frame residual report checked against installation measurements. Accuracy is established during commissioning.

services.title: Controller traces and IO correlation
services.summary: Extend Cycle Inspector to recorded controller telemetry with robot, CNC and PLC signal correlation.
services.requirements: Controller versions, enabled RTDE, output recipes, PLC signal mapping, clock strategy and representative recordings.
services.deliverable: A read-only recorder with controller timestamps, gap / stale-data indicators and measured acquisition quality; hardware traces stay distinct from simulated cycles.

services.title: OPC UA machine and robot integration
services.summary: Connect machine status, alarms and job information through the companion models supported by the installation.
services.requirements: OPC UA endpoints, supported namespaces, certificates, node inventory, vendor options and a read-only test environment.
services.deliverable: A mapped monitoring adapter and interoperability tests for the agreed Machine Tools / Robotics subset. PLC interlock control requires a separate scope.

services.title: Motion planning and cycle optimization
services.summary: Evaluate collision-aware paths and constrained trajectory timing using a scoped MoveIt 2 integration.
services.requirements: Calibrated collision geometry, joint velocity / acceleration / jerk limits, tooling, payload and process constraints.
services.deliverable: Benchmarked candidate paths, timing and collision rechecks after time parameterization; jerk smoothing where supported. Gains require measured validation.

services.title: Virtual commissioning and fault campaigns
services.summary: Extend sequence regression to a Gazebo / ros2_control model and agreed PLC or controller test interfaces.
services.requirements: URDF / SDF assets, controller and PLC interfaces, actuator behavior, interlocks, recovery rules and acceptance scenarios.
services.deliverable: A versioned simulation environment with repeatable fault / recovery scenarios and explicit model limitations; installation acceptance remains a separate activity.
